#### periodicPlate (elastodynamics)

Wave propagation in a fully periodic square plate, solved with the vectorial
lattice Boltzmann scheme for the Navier--Cauchy equation on a `VECTOR<D2Q4>`
descriptor. A manufactured solution drives the body force, so displacement,
velocity and stress can be compared against the exact fields at every time
step. Because both directions are periodic, no boundary condition is involved,
which makes this the reference case for the bulk collision alone.

The `run.sh` script sweeps the resolution from 30 to 120 and averages the
experimental order of convergence of all three quantities into
`tmp/gnuplotData/data/eoc.csv`.
